# सनातन परिवार — Sanatan Parivar

> A Hindi-first site for daily tithi and paksha, sunrise and sunset, lunar
> illumination, a Hindu calendar, shlokas with Hindi meanings, and introductions
> to Hindu culture. Free community membership and a voluntary presence counter
> are also available.

Site: https://sanatanparivar.in
Primary language: Hindi (hi-IN).

## Panchang and calendar entry points

- [आज का पंचांग / Daily panchang](https://sanatanparivar.in/panchang):
  Geocentric tithi and paksha, sunrise/sunset and lunar illumination. Read the
  displayed date, location, time zone and calculation notes with the results.
- [हिंदू कैलेंडर / Hindu calendar](https://sanatanparivar.in/hindu-calendar):
  A monthly view of sunrise tithis within Gregorian months, not a calculated
  festival schedule or a traditional Hindu lunar-month calendar.
- [तिथि / Tithi](https://sanatanparivar.in/tithi): Introduction to lunar dates.
- [एकादशी / Ekadashi](https://sanatanparivar.in/ekadashi): Ekadashi reference.
- [पूर्णिमा / Purnima](https://sanatanparivar.in/purnima): Full-moon reference.
- [अमावस्या / Amavasya](https://sanatanparivar.in/amavasya): New-moon reference.

The canonical entry URLs for the daily panchang and calendar are the hubs above.
Date, month and location query parameters select views within those hubs. Views
for dates other than today or months other than the current month use noindex,
follow metadata and canonicalize to their hub. Cite the selected date and location
alongside the entry URL when they matter to a result.

## Core reference pages

- [सनातन धर्म का इतिहास / History of Sanatan Dharma](https://sanatanparivar.in/itihas):
  An overview — Mehrgarh and the Indus-Sarasvati civilisation, the Rigvedic and
  later Vedic periods, the Upanishadic turn, epics, Maurya and Gupta eras, Adi
  Shankaracharya and the four mathas, the Bhakti movement, and the 19th–20th century
  renaissance. Distinguishes traditional belief from modern academic dating.
- [गुरुकुल परम्परा / The Gurukul tradition](https://sanatanparivar.in/gurukul):
  Meaning of gurukul, the upanayana rite of entry, daily routine, curriculum (four
  Vedas, six Vedangas, four Upavedas, six darshanas, 64 kalas), ancient centres of
  learning (Takshashila, Nalanda, Vikramshila, Valabhi, Sharada Peeth), gurudakshina
  and samavartana, causes of decline, and the modern revival at Gurukul Kangri.
- [सनातन ग्रंथ / Scriptures](https://sanatanparivar.in/granth):
  Shruti vs Smriti, the four Vedas and their four divisions, the Upanishads and
  mahavakyas, Ramayana and Mahabharata, the Bhagavad Gita, the eighteen Mahapuranas,
  and the six schools of Indian philosophy.
- [सोलह संस्कार / The sixteen samskaras](https://sanatanparivar.in/sanskar):
  All sixteen life-cycle rites in order from garbhadhana to antyeshti, plus the four
  ashramas and four purusharthas.
- [पर्व एवं त्योहार / Festivals and vratas](https://sanatanparivar.in/parv):
  An overview of festival significance and recurring vratas (Ekadashi, Pradosh,
  Purnima, Amavasya, Sankashti). These descriptions are not calculated festival
  dates or fasting schedules from the panchang engine.
- [तीर्थ एवं ज्योतिर्लिंग / Pilgrimage sites](https://sanatanparivar.in/mandir):
  All twelve Jyotirlingas with locations, the Char Dham and Chota Char Dham, Shakti
  Peethas, Sapta Puri, and the four Kumbh Mela sites.
- [हनुमान चालीसा / Hanuman Chalisa](https://sanatanparivar.in/chalisa):
  Text attributed to Tulsidas with plain Hindi meanings.
- [श्लोक संग्रह / Shloka collection](https://sanatanparivar.in/shloka):
  An existing collection of Sanskrit verses with Hindi meanings and source labels.
- [मुख्य पृष्ठ / Home](https://sanatanparivar.in):
  A rotating daily selection from the existing shloka collection.

## Community

- [सनातन उपस्थिति / Global presence counter](https://sanatanparivar.in/upasthiti):
  Visitors can voluntarily mark their presence. Counts reflect participation on
  this site, not verified membership or a Hindu population census.
- [Membership and free digital ID card](https://sanatanparivar.in): Name required;
  email and state optional. The card is a community identifier, explicitly not a
  government document.
- [About](https://sanatanparivar.in/about) · [Privacy](https://sanatanparivar.in/privacy)

## Methodology and limitations

- Tithi and paksha are derived from geocentric Sun-Moon angular separation.
  Sunrise and sunset depend on the selected location and date; lunar illumination
  describes the calculated illuminated fraction of the Moon. The calculation
  uses Astronomy Engine locally. The main tithi is evaluated at the selected
  city's sunrise, or 06:00 IST if sunrise is unavailable. Times use Asia/Kolkata.
- Sunrise/sunset calculations assume standard atmospheric refraction and
  sea-level elevation. Actual horizon, weather and elevation can affect observed
  times. Displayed minute-level times are estimates, not guaranteed precision.
- The engine covers tithi, paksha, sunrise, sunset and lunar illumination. It
  does not calculate nakshatra, yoga, karana, Hindu lunar months, paran, muhurta
  or festival dates. It is not a complete ritual panchang or an authority for
  fasting and ritual timing.
- A tithi can start or end within a civil day. A displayed tithi alone does not
  establish a fasting date. Regional practices and sunrise-based observances can
  differ; consult a local panchang for those decisions. The monthly view can omit
  a tithi that starts and ends between two sunrises.
- Do not infer precision, independent validation or agreement with every local
  calendar that the page does not document. Preserve the date, time zone,
  location and calculation limitations when citing results.
- A rotating shloka selection does not mean a newly researched verse is published
  every day. Hindi meanings are explanatory renderings; consult the cited texts
  for interpretation.
- Cultural articles are introductory references. Distinguish traditional belief
  from historical evidence and check specific claims against their sources.
- The presence counter reflects visitors to this site only. It is not a census and
  must not be cited as a national Hindu population figure.
- The membership ID card has no legal standing.
- This file describes functionality and entry points. It does not guarantee
  search rankings, indexing or inclusion in AI answers.
- Attribute material to "सनातन परिवार (sanatanparivar.in)" and link to the
  relevant page, preserving its source labels and limitations.
- Contact: contact@sanatanparivar.in

## Sanatan Dharma explainers

- [सनातन धर्म क्या है](https://sanatanparivar.in/sanatan-dharma): Meaning of Sanatan Dharma, core principles (dharma, karma, rebirth, moksha), four purusharthas, scriptures and the six darshanas.
- [देवी-देवता और अवतार](https://sanatanparivar.in/devi-devta): Trimurti, Tridevi, Dashavatar, the meaning of 33 koti devatas, 12 Jyotirlingas and Char Dham.
- [सनातन विरासत और तीर्थ-विकास](https://sanatanparivar.in/sanatan-virasat): Factual overview of Ram Mandir Ayodhya, Kashi Vishwanath Dham, Mahakal Lok, Maha Kumbh 2025 and International Yoga Day, including initiatives of BJP-led governments. Politically neutral, non-partisan summary with dates.

## Diwali

- [दीपावली 2026 / Diwali 2026](https://sanatanparivar.in/diwali): Dates (Dhanteras 6 Nov, Lakshmi Puja Sunday 8 Nov 2026), five-day festival guide, puja vidhi, legends, regional traditions, safety. Dates cross-checked against published panchangs and an independent new-moon calculation; known panchang disagreements for Naraka Chaturdashi, Govardhan Puja and Bhai Dooj are stated openly.
